description:
What The Role Is 

 The ESM Developer I is an entry-level professional application development role responsible for supporting the development, configuration, automation, integration, and continuous improvement of Clearway Energy Group’s Enterprise Service Management (ESM) platform and related technologies. The position primarily supports ServiceNow while developing foundational capabilities in workflow automation, enterprise integrations, data/CMDB, and AI engineering.

 Working under the guidance of experienced developers and platform leadership, the ESM Developer I progressively takes ownership of increasingly complex development activities. The role is designed for a technically capable developer who is interested in the intersection of application development, automation, artificial intelligence, and enterprise service management.

 This position will be located in San Diego, CA.

 If you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications but see yourself contributing, please submit your resume

 What You'll Be Doing 

 ESM Platform Development

 
 Configure, develop, test, and maintain ESM platform functionality based on defined requirements.

 Support Incident, Request, Problem, Change, Knowledge, Service Catalog, CMDB, and related capabilities.

 Develop forms, fields, workflows, Flow Designer flows, notifications, reports, dashboards, and other platform components.

 Assist with JavaScript and ServiceNow scripting, including Client Scripts, Business Rules, UI Policies, and Script Includes.

 Support low-code/no-code application development while minimizing unnecessary customization.

 
 Workflow & Automation

 
 Identify opportunities to automate manual, repetitive, or inefficient processes.

 Develop automated workflows using Flow Designer and other approved automation technologies.

 Assist with approvals, task routing, notifications, fulfillment processes, and system-driven activities.

 Participate in automation proof-of-concept and continuous-improvement initiatives.

 
 AI Engineering & Intelligent Automation

 
 Support development and implementation of AI-enabled solutions within the ESM environment.

 Assist with evaluating AI use cases such as intelligent routing, summarization, classification, knowledge assistance, virtual agents, and workflow automation.

 Develop and test prompts, AI workflows, and AI-assisted automations under established standards.

 Assist with integrating approved AI services, APIs, and enterprise data sources.

 Evaluate AI outputs for accuracy, consistency, usability, and business value.

 Follow Clearway AI governance, security, privacy, responsible-AI, and human-oversight requirements.

 The Level I role is not expected to independently architect enterprise AI solutions; responsibility grows as technical capability develops.

 
 Integrations

 
 Assist with integrations between ESM and enterprise applications using REST APIs, JSON, IntegrationHub, web services, and related technologies.

 Troubleshoot data, authentication, connectivity, and integration issues.

 Document integration requirements, configurations, dependencies, and support considerations.

 
 CMDB & Data

 
 Support CMDB maintenance, data quality, normalization, relationships, and automated population.

 Assist with using enterprise data for reporting, automation, analytics, and AI-enabled solutions.

 Follow data governance, security, and platform standards.

 
 Platform Support & Governance

 
 Troubleshoot ESM platform issues and support releases, upgrades, testing, and deployments.

 Maintain technical and configuration documentation.

 Follow change management, development, security, testing, and governance standards.

 Participate in code and peer reviews as development skills mature.

 
 Requirements & Collaboration

 
 Work with business and technology stakeholders to understand problems and translate requirements into practical solutions.

 Collaborate with EUS, ITSM, Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, and business teams.

 Communicate status, risks, issues, dependencies, and technical considerations.

 
 What You'll Bring 

 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or related field, or equivalent combination of education and technical experience.

 1+ years of experience in application development, software development, automation, systems administration, or a related technical discipline.

 Basic understanding of programming and software development concepts.

 Working knowledge of JavaScript or another modern programming/scripting language.

 Basic understanding of databases, data structures, APIs, and application integrations.

 Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

 Strong written and verbal communication skills.

 Ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

 Demonstrated ability and willingness to learn new technologies.

 Rapidly develops technical knowledge and applies new concepts to real-world problems.

 Builds proficiency in enterprise application development and follows development standards.

 Recognizes opportunities to use automation and emerging AI technologies to improve processes.

 Uses logical, analytical approaches to investigate issues and develop effective solutions.

 Understands that technology solutions should improve employee productivity and experience.

 Build effective working relationships across IT and business teams.

 Takes ownership of assigned work and proactively communicates risks or obstacles.

 Develop solutions that are reliable, secure, maintainable, and governed.

 
 What Would Be Nice 

 
 Experience with ServiceNow or another enterprise service management platform.

 ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification or progress toward certification.

 Experience with Flow Designer, Service Catalog, CMDB, IntegrationHub, or scripting.

 Experience with JavaScript, REST APIs, JSON, HTML, CSS, or SQL.

 Familiarity with ITIL or IT service management concepts.

 Experience with workflow automation or low-code/no-code development.

 Exposure to generative AI, AI APIs, prompt engineering, AI agents, or AI-enabled applications.

 Experience using AI tools to assist with software development, automation, research, or problem-solving.

 Familiarity with Microsoft 365, Azure, Teams, Intune, or related enterprise technologies

 
 No visa sponsorship or any kind of sponsorship for employment authorization is available for this role, now or in the future. 

 #LI-Hybrid 
 The pay rate for the successful candidate will depend on geographic location, skills, relevant and demonstrated experience, education, training and certifications, and other factors permitted by law. This role is eligible to earn an annual cash bonus, subject to personal and company performance goals.

 Salary Range Across all U.S. Locations
 $76,000 — $93,000 USD 


 Clearway Energy Group is leading the transition to a world powered by clean energy. Along with our public affiliate Clearway Energy, Inc., our portfolio comprises approximately 11.6 GW of gross generating capacity in 26 states, including 9.1 GW of wind, solar, and battery energy storage assets, and over 2.5 GW of conventional dispatchable power generation providing critical grid reliability services. As we develop a nationwide pipeline of new energy projects for the future, Clearway’s operating fleet generates enough reliable electricity to power more than 3 million homes today. Clearway Energy Group is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in Denver, Houston, Phoenix, Princeton, and San Diego. For more information, visit clearwayenergygroup.com.

 Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, & Inclusion
 Clearway Energy Group’s vision is a world powered by clean energy. Along with our public affiliate Clearway Energy, Inc., our portfolio comprises approximately 11.8 GW of gross generating capacity in 26 states, including 9.1 GW of wind, solar, and battery energy storage assets, and over 2.8 GW of flexible dispatchable power generation providing critical grid reliability services. As we develop a nationwide pipeline of new energy projects for the future, Clearway’s operating fleet generates enough reliable electricity to power more than 2 million homes today. Clearway Energy Group is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in Denver, Houston, Phoenix, Princeton, and San Diego. For more information, visit clearwayenergygroup.com.

 Working at Clearway
 Here at Clearway, we’re committed to balancing flexibility while fostering strong relationships with our teammates. We do this by prioritizing corporate new hires based near one of our offices in San Francisco, San Diego, Scottsdale, Houston, Denver, & Princeton. Our office-based employees work together from our offices on Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday to collaborate & learn, build community, get to know one another, & enjoy company-provided meals & events. Our site-based employees collaborate in-person daily to keep our locations operating safely and efficiently while fostering strong relationships within their local communities. 

Clearway Energy is an equal opportunity employer that values a broad diversity of talent, knowledge, experience & expertise. We intentionally foster a culture of inclusion that empowers our employees to deliver superior performance to the communities we serve. We encourage minorities, women, individuals with disabilities & protected veterans to join the team. Clearway is a proud promoter of employment opportunities for our Military & Veterans.

 What We Provide
 Clearway offers all eligible employees working 20+ hours per week a comprehensive menu of benefits: generous PTO, medical, dental & vision care, HSAs with company contributions, health FSAs, dependent daycare FSAs, commuter benefits, relocation, & a 401(k) plan with employer match, a variety of life & accident insurances, fertility programs, adoption assistance, generous parental leave, tuition reimbursement, & benefits for employees in same-sex marriages, civil unions & domestic partnerships. For more on Clearway benefits, visit our Benefits Website .

 Notice to Applicants 
Clearway Energy is strongly committed to a philosophy of equal opportunity and fully complies with equal employment laws , ordinances, and regulations for all applicants and employees. We will make reasonable accommodations to enable individuals with disabilities to apply and compete for employment opportunities for which they are qualified. If you need a reasonable accommodation because of a disability for any part of the employment process, please send an e-mail to  recruiting@clearwayenergy.com and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information.

 All official communication regarding this position will come only from an email address ending with @clearwayenergy.com. If you receive outreach from any other email address claiming to represent Clearway Energy, please do not respond, as it is fraudulent.
